Bill.BriefDescription: Including charts in the voters' pamphlet.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to information included in the voters' pamphlet;and adding a new section to chapter 29A.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For each voters' pamphlet prepared for the general election, theoffice of financial management shall prepare the following charts: (1) A pie chart showing the amount of state revenues generated bymajor type of tax; (2) A table comparing the general fundstate revenues with thegeneral fund-state expenditures by county; (3) A pie chart showing general fundstate expenditures by majorexpenditure category; (4) A bar chart showing the percent of income paid in federal,state, and local taxes by income brackets, as follows: (a) Under twenty thousand dollars; (b) Between twenty thousand dollars and thirty thousand dollars; (c) Between thirty thousand dollars and forty thousand dollars; (d) Between forty thousand dollars and fifty thousand dollars; p. 1 HB 2296 (e) Between fifty thousand dollars and sixty thousand dollars; (f) Between sixty thousand dollars and seventy thousand dollars; (g) Between seventy thousand dollars and eighty thousand dollars; (h) Between eighty thousand dollars and one hundred thousanddollars; (i) Between one hundred thousand dollars and one hundred twentyfive thousand dollars; (j) Between one hundred twentyfive thousand dollars and onehundred fifty thousand dollars; (k) Between one hundred fifty thousand dollars and one hundredseventyfive thousand dollars; and (l) Over one hundred seventyfive thousand dollars. Each chart must contain a brief description in neutral terms. Thecharts must be placed on consecutive pages in the voters' pamphlet.
